patch.summary:
Thesis: General-purpose vs specialist — Shopify documents a broader use-case set; Saleor is narrower/specialist.

Comparison thesis: General-purpose vs specialist. Choose Saleor only if your buying job matches “Headless GraphQL commerce — OSS self-host free; Cloud Select $1599/mo, Volume $3999/mo, En” rather than Shopify's shape. Choose Shopify only if your buying job matches “Hosted SaaS ecommerce platform with themes, checkout, channels, and POS — Basic from $39/m” rather than Saleor's shape. Workflow advantage: Saleor leans shared coverage; Shopify leans catalog-management, checkout-conversion. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: General-purpose vs specialist — Shopify documents a broader use-case set; Saleor is narrower/specialist.
- Positioning: Saleor is Headless GraphQL commerce — OSS self-host free; Cloud Select $1599/mo, Volume $3999/mo, Enterprise quote. Forever Free is non-commercial onl; Shopify is Hosted SaaS ecommerce platform with themes, checkout, channels, and POS — Basic from $39/mo ($29 annual), Grow $105 ($79 annual), Advanced $.
- Company-size focus: Saleor (mid-market, enterprise) vs Shopify (solo, micro, small-business).
- Workflow coverage skew: Saleor-leaning — vs Shopify-leaning catalog-management, checkout-conversion, omnichannel-retail.
- Researched limits: Saleor — Cloud Select floor ($1599/mo) is high versus WooCommerce hosting TCO; Shopify — Subscription plus apps/themes and payment spreads raise TCO versus headline plan price.

Limitations — Saleor: Cloud Select floor ($1599/mo) is high versus WooCommerce hosting TCO; Forever Free Cloud is non-commercial — not a production merchant free plan; Shopify: Subscription plus apps/themes and payment spreads raise TCO versus headline plan price; Third-party payment gateways incur additional transaction fees on lower tiers.

Poor-fit cases: Saleor is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Cloud Select floor ($1599/mo) is high versus WooCommerce hosting TCO · Shopify is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Subscription plus apps/themes and payment spreads raise TCO versus headline plan price · Avoid Saleor if you actually need Shopify's motion (Hosted SaaS ecommerce platform with themes, checkout, channels, and POS — Basic )

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
